original.target_description: Study 4, Table 1, Attraction composite (liking to work on a project, liking as a friend, respect), omnibus one-way ANOVA across obedient, rebel control (nonaffirmed), and rebel self-affirmation conditions. Supplied p. 11 corresponds to printed p. 86, the Attraction omnibus table.

notes: Identity assessed independently from the supplied text: title The Rejection of Moral Rebels: Resenting Those Who Do the Right Thing; Benoît Monin (rendered Benoı̂t), Pamela J. Sawyer, Matthew J. Marquez; Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 2008, Vol. 95, No. 1, 76–93; DOI 10.1037/0022-3514.95.1.76. This is a full primary article text with methods, results, references and appendix, rather than an abstract or secondary report. The supplied text contains 18 page breaks. No local PDF is named in the input, so PDF layout could not be rendered; evidence uses literal canonical-text fragments. The page locator and description spanning nonaffirmed and self-affirmed actors identify Table 1’s three-condition Attraction omnibus F test. The effect value preserves the requested printed test statistic, rather than substituting Cohen’s d. The ** legend provides a strict p < .01 bound for this same F test. Table 1 also provides pairwise p < .05 comparisons and p. 87 reports separate regression tests; these are distinct candidates for narrower contrasts and were not substituted for the omnibus test. Original n and every replication/success field are unassigned placeholders.
